children: Public Bank's plans to take unit Public Financial private could give the Malaysian lender greater flexibility over business planning, resource allocation and capital optimization, even if the earnings impact is immaterial, CIMB Securities analyst Ei Leen Tan says in a note. Full ownership should also simplify Public Financial's ownership structure, reduce listing and compliance costs, and allow resources to be redeployed to core banking operations, she says. Tan is largely neutral on the proposed take-private exercise, given limited impact on earnings, capital and valuation. CIMB maintains a buy rating on Public Bank and keeps its target price at 5.50 ringgit. Shares are 0.2% lower at 4.99 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
